name: ML Experimentation & Research Methodology
description: Scientific hypothesis testing, experimental design, baseline modeling, ablation studies, error slicing, and reproducible discovery.

subskills.name: Scientific Hypothesis Formulation & Problem Structuring
subskills.description: Translating ambiguous business/scientific problems into testable ML hypotheses with clear dependent/independent variables.

subskills.name: Experimental Design & Statistical Power Analysis
subskills.description: Sample size determination, minimum detectable effect (MDE), significance level (alpha), statistical power (1-beta), and randomized trials.

subskills.name: Statistical Significance, P-values & Multiple Testing
subskills.description: Parametric/non-parametric tests (t-test, Mann-Whitney U, ANOVA), Bonferroni/FDR corrections, and bootstrapping confidence intervals.

subskills.name: Baseline Model Formulation & Simple Benchmark Heuristics
subskills.description: Establishing zero-cost baselines (majority class, mean/median, heuristic rules) to rigorously justify model complexity increases.

subskills.name: Cohort Error Analysis & Data Slicing Diagnostics
subskills.description: Residual inspection, error taxonomy categorization, slice-based evaluation to identify systemic failure modes in subpopulations.

subskills.name: Ablation Studies & Model Component Isolation
subskills.description: Systematic removal of architectural components, regularizers, or feature subsets to isolate causal performance drivers.

subskills.name: Research Reproducibility, Deterministic Seeds & Environment Pinning
subskills.description: Deterministic CUDA execution, random seed management across NumPy/PyTorch/Python, environment pinning for exact replication.

subskills.name: Primary vs Guardrail Metrics & Strategic Trade-off Analysis
subskills.description: Selecting primary optimization objectives vs guardrail/constraint metrics (e.g. latency vs accuracy, precision vs recall trade-offs).

subskills.name: SOTA Literature Review & Standardized Benchmarking
subskills.description: Tracking ArXiv research, evaluating models on benchmark suites (GLUE, SuperGLUE, ImageNet, MMLU), and reproducing papers.
